title: TinyViT
description: Microsoft's TinyViT (Wu et al. 2022; 5M, 11M and 21M parameters at 224, 21M also at 384 and 512; ImageNet-22k distilled, fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k): a small hybrid classifier…
html:
Microsoft's TinyViT (Wu et al. 2022; 5M, 11M and 21M parameters at 224, 21M also at 384 and 512; ImageNet-22k distilled, fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k): a small hybrid classifier of MBConv blocks and window attention. Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: TinyViT: Fast Pretraining Distillation for Small Vision Transformers, ECCV 2022, 2022-07-21
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/microsoft/Cream/tree/main/TinyViT (PyTorch): timm carries the architecture and the converted authors' checkpoints in its own, simpler API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/tiny_vit_21m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k/blob/bcd5d68c5650bf4d65a0a1262f28b699a4d1c35f/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-21k / ImageNet-22k (full ImageNet, fall 2011 release), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv
  • Variants: tiny_vit_5m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k, tiny_vit_11m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k, tiny_vit_21m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k, tiny_vit_21m_384.dist_in22k_ft_in1k (default of tiny_vit_21m_384), tiny_vit_21m_512.dist_in22k_ft_in1k (default of tiny_vit_21m_512)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size:
    • tiny_vit_5m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k, tiny_vit_11m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k, tiny_vit_21m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 235) and centre-cropped to it
    • tiny_vit_21m_384.dist_in22k_ft_in1k: fixed 384x384: the input is resized (short side 384) and centre-cropped to it
    • tiny_vit_21m_512.dist_in22k_ft_in1k: fixed 512x512: the input is resized (short side 512) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): tiny_vit_5m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); tiny_vit_11m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); tiny_vit_21m_224.dist_in22k_ft_in1k 224x224 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); tiny_vit_21m_384.dist_in22k_ft_in1k 384x384 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.2 reserved); tiny_vit_21m_512.dist_in22k_ft_in1k 512x512 (0.3 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved)
